svg.text: Proprietary savic-net fieldbus · 67 RS/DDC panels · 4,467 I/O points
ビルマネジメントサーバ
6 × SCS — each heads up to 4 NC-bus lines → ≤24 segments
Each line is a daisy-chain of RS remote stations + DDC:
Trunk segments (2002 伝送幹線系統図): UIC1-1/1-2 · UIC2-1…2-4 · UIC3-1/3-2 risers to 10F/21F/31F · UIC4-1…4-3 + UIC4-C basements. Totals: 67 panels · 4,467 points.
